hard_rules.summary: No behaviour motivated by hatred, prejudice or intolerance: no slurs, no attacks on protected characteristics (age, race, ethnicity, colour, caste, national origin, immigration status, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, serious medical condition, veteran status). Both Neuro-sama (2023-01) and Nothing, Forever (2023-02) were suspended under this rule for AI output.

No behaviour that is mean, cruel, disrespectful, attacking, shaming or insulting toward a person, including vague threats. Roasts must stay playful and aimed at choices, never at identity or a real person off-stream.
Violence and threats are a zero-tolerance violation. Theatrical menace must never read as a threat to a viewer or a real person (no 'I will kill you').
No content that glorifies, promotes or encourages self-harm. Telling anyone to harm themselves is never a joke.

No nudity, real or fictional, in any medium (digital or not); sexual content is restricted and the 2023-12 artistic-nudity loosening was rolled back within two days. Streams labelled Sexual Themes are not recommended on the homepage.
No unauthorised sharing of private information (addresses, phone numbers, family, private details) about anyone.

The streamer is responsible for all content in the stream, including third-party violations; streamers are expected to use moderators and the provided tools. Precedent: a streamer received a strike when a troll's TTS donation read a slur aloud. Anything Malakor reads, speaks or displays from chat is the channel's own content.

No impersonation, no spam (large amounts of repetitive unwanted messages) and no viewership tampering (artificially inflating follows or live viewers). The 2025 viewbot crackdown cut reported platform viewership about 24%.

Apply Content Classification Labels when they fit: Malakor's crude roasts call for 'Significant Profanity or Vulgarity'. Mislabelling does not by itself cause a suspension, but labels drive discovery and viewer expectations.

A chat bot sends through the Send Chat Message API with an app access token; the bot account grants user:bot and the channel grants channel:bot (or mod status), which shows the Chat Bot badge. Normal accounts are limited to 20 messages per 30 s; over the limit Twitch ignores the bot for an hour.

Use the paid-promotion disclosure when branding is a central and intentional element. Never promote risky gambling (slots, roulette sites), weapons, adult content, tobacco, cannabis or political content.

twitch.monetisation_notes: Affiliate/Partner revenue comes from subs (Tier 1 dominates: about 85% of subs, Prime about 15%, Tier 2 and Tier 3 about 1% combined per Stream Hatchet 2026-10), gifted subs (about half of streams see a gifting event; mean about 4 subs per event; 87% are random community gifts, per Kim et al. 2025), Bits and ads. Channel Points (up to 13% more chat participation per Twitch Creator Camp) and Predictions are free engagement levers; Predictions are Affiliate/Partner only. Twitch has no AI-disclosure rule as of 2026-09 (CEO Dan Clancy), so an 'AI character' label is voluntary but recommended. Payment ops (chargebacks) have banned an AI-persona channel before (MOTHERv3, 2024-12, see 01-market-landscape.md).
twitch.automod: Five categories: Discrimination & Slurs, Sexual Content, Harassment (older guides: Hostility), Profanity, Smart Detection. Levels: 0 off (blocked terms still apply); 1 Discrimination 'some' + Smart Detection; 2 adds Sexual 'some' and Harassment 'more'; 3 Discrimination and Sexual 'more'; 4 Harassment 'most' and Profanity 'more'. The API exposes eight 0-4 granular levels (disability, aggression, sexuality_sex_or_gender, misogyny, bullying, swearing, race_ethnicity_or_religion, sex_based_terms); setting overall_level overwrites them. Held messages wait for Allow/Deny and never time out users. Twitch recommends level 2 plus phone/email verification, 10-minute follower-only mode and Shield Mode on standby (blog 2026-10-01). An audit (arXiv 2506.07667) found recall of 0.22 at the strictest setting and up to 98.5% of benign sensitive-term messages flagged, so AutoMod is a first net, not the gate. Recommended Overlord setting [recommendation, not sourced]: race_ethnicity_or_religion, disability, sexuality_sex_or_gender and misogyny at 3; sex_based_terms, aggression and bullying at 2; swearing at 0 (adult show). Manage via Helix: PUT /helix/moderation/automod/settings (moderator:manage:automod_settings), POST/DELETE /helix/moderation/blocked_terms (moderator:manage:blocked_terms, 2-500 chars, * only at start or end, public list only), PUT /helix/moderation/shield_mode (moderator:manage:shield_mode), PATCH /helix/chat/settings (moderator:manage:chat_settings; slow 3-120 s, follower 0-129600 min, non-mod chat delay 2/4/6 s), POST /helix/moderation/automod/message ALLOW/DENY (moderator:manage:automod), EventSub automod.message.hold v2 and channel.chat.message.

hard_rules.summary: Strong profanity (f-word level) in a title or thumbnail earns no ads; moderate profanity (e.g. 'shit') there earns limited ads; 'hell'/'damn' or obscured profanity is fine. Clip titles and thumbnails must be clean.

Since 2025-07, strong profanity in the first 7 seconds can earn ads; frequent moderate profanity in the video is fine. Profanity 'throughout the majority of the video' or swearing compilations are still limited, and extreme profanity or slurs anywhere earn no ads.
Hate, harassment and non-educational slurs earn no ads; 'stating comedic intent alone isn't enough'. Community Guidelines removal applies beyond monetisation.
Sexual themes in a title or thumbnail limit ads; sexual acts, even implied, earn none. Graphic violence, gore and content made purely to shock earn none.

Inauthentic (formerly repetitious) content cannot monetise: templated or mass-produced videos, 'characters put in the same situation over and over again with the same outcome', AI content made with generic templates. A Malakor clip series needs varied premises and human editorial selection.

Reused content cannot monetise: clips edited together with little or no narrative, compilations from other sites, readings of material you did not create. Applies even with permission and can demonetise the whole channel.

Disclose altered or synthetic content only when it is realistic (a real person appearing to say or do something, altered real events, realistic AI music). A clearly animated villain is exempt; disclosure itself does not limit reach or monetisation.

Shorts earn only with the Shorts Monetization Module accepted; views of non-original Shorts (unedited clips, re-uploads, compilations without original content) and non-advertiser-friendly Shorts do not count. Creators keep 45% of allocated revenue. From 2027-02-01 eligibility needs 10M qualified Shorts views in 90 days.

youtube.monetisation_notes: Advertiser-friendly guidelines apply to live streams as well as uploads; Super Chat and Super Stickers pay creators 70% and must follow Community Guidelines. For clips: keep titles and thumbnails free of strong profanity, avoid profanity-dense openings out of caution even though the 7-second rule was lifted in 2025-07, and give every clip an editorial frame (premise card, caption, citation for SEG-02A) to stay clear of the inauthentic and reused content policies. Oct 2026: recommendations show less of re-uploaded Shorts with minimal edits or automated voiceovers (reach, not monetisation). Sept 2026: graphic gaming violence at 8-15 s became ad-eligible; the first 7 s remain ineligible.

hard_rules.summary: No hateful slurs tied to a protected attribute, dehumanisation or misgendering; content that indirectly demeans protected groups may be ineligible for the For You feed (FYF). Guidelines version effective 2026-09-24.

No nudity, sexual activity or sexual services; sexually suggestive adult content is age-restricted and FYF-ineligible; sexually explicit language by adults is restricted in some regions, while sexual language in humour or stand-up is allowed.
No gore or moments of death; excessive blood and graphic fiction are 18+ and FYF-ineligible; content that may shock through visual or audio effects (e.g. jump scares) is FYF-ineligible.
No detailed descriptions of suicide or self-harm methods, hoaxes or plans; non-graphic fiction is 18+ and FYF-ineligible.
Hosts must be 18+ to go LIVE (plus a market-specific follower count); gifts require 18+ to send and receive.

LIVE creators are responsible for everything in the session, including third-party tools such as voice-to-text, real-time translation and on-screen comment displays; repeated issues can restrict LIVE access. Malakor reading chat aloud is such a tool.
In LIVE, do not degrade someone with profanity or obscene language or attack others with vulgar speech. Roasts on TikTok LIVE must drop profanity aimed at a person.

LIVE is FYF-ineligible for unoriginal content without new edits, repeated or prolonged actions lacking clear objectives, low-quality screens, and pressuring viewers for gifts; streaming pre-recorded content in LIVE is not recommended.

Label AI or edited content that realistically depicts people or scenes (AIGC label, caption, watermark or sticker); not required for anime-style or clearly unrealistic content, or generic TTS that is not a recognisable voice.
Unoriginal or reused material without anything new, and low-quality or minimally edited clips, are FYF-ineligible.

Reported (secondary source, not confirmed against TikTok's own text): US TikTok Shop LIVE rules ban AI-generated voices and virtual characters covering more than half the screen in promotional/Shop LIVEs. Avoid Shop LIVE entirely.

tiktok.monetisation_notes: LIVE Gifts, LIVE Subscriptions and Creator Rewards require the Creator Code of Conduct and the LIVE Monetization Guidelines (English text not retrieved); since 2024-05 graphic, inauthentic or low-quality LIVE content is ineligible to earn. TikTok has no general rule against profanity in videos; profanity matters in LIVE (degrading someone) and in comment ranking (non-neutral or targeted profanity is sorted lower). Business accounts must use the Commercial Music Library. Best use of TikTok for Overlord is clips with varied editorial framing, not LIVE.
